In the center of the twisted time-space.

“I have met the nine supreme beings.” Lin Yuan slightly bowed to show respect.

After stepping into the Eleventh Level, Lin Yuan immediately came to meet the supreme beings.

After all, during the breakthrough, the nine supreme beings had been shielding his aura.

The Eleventh Level’s impact on the ultimate, with or without the protection of the supreme beings, was different.

Especially since Lin Yuan did not impact the ultimate, he never attempted the ultimate leap, and there existed a possibility of interference during the breakthrough.

“No need for this, I believe it won’t be long before our human civilization establishes the tenth Evolution Tower,” the Ancient Power Supreme Being spoke.

Human civilization currently had nine Evolution Towers, corresponding to the nine supreme beings.

The tenth Evolution Tower signified the birth of the tenth supreme being in human civilization.

Entering the Eleventh Level and being evaluated by the Ancient Power Supreme Being in such a manner showed the importance placed on Lin Yuan.

To a certain extent, the Ancient Power Supreme Being already regarded Lin Yuan as the future supreme being.

“Compared to the supreme beings, I still have a long way to go,” Lin Yuan immediately said.

The more he cultivated, the more Lin Yuan felt the gap between the Twelfth and Eleventh Levels.

The two were not on the same level of existence at all. Even if the Eleventh Level was stronger, it could only live in the river of time. Even if it could briefly leap up, it would eventually fall back.

And the Twelfth Level? It completely broke free from the restraints of the river of time, standing on the bank overlooking countless river-life struggles.

The difference between the two was not just a chasm in realm and strength, but also entirely different mindsets.

“Do not belittle yourself. If even you cannot step into the Twelfth Level, then neither our human civilization nor the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Skies will produce a Twelfth Level,”

the Ancient Power Supreme Being said, “Walking the path of evolution requires appropriate humility, but also confidence.”

The other eight supreme beings nodded slightly. Through the commotion of Lin Yuan’s breakthrough to the Eleventh Level, they vaguely speculated on how profound the foundation of this Galaxy Master was.

Tearing open the cosmic space rift and welcoming the arrival of the Chaos Void Origin was entirely based on one’s circumstances.

No one could fake this aspect.

Lin Yun, with his Tenth Level realm, tore open the cosmic space rift that was no smaller than those torn open by the Eleventh Level perfect beings impacting the ultimate.

Given his realm was not as high as the latter, the space rift he finally tore was the same, meaning Lin Yuan surpassed the Eleventh Level perfect beings in other respects.

This was what most shocked the nine supreme beings of human civilization.

“The supreme being is correct,” Lin Yuan immediately said.

*However, he couldn’t help but mutter in his heart.*

*What he meant was that compared to the supreme beings, he was still far behind merely in terms of combat strength.*

*Now, Lin Yuan’s combat strength greatly exceeded the Eleventh Level perfect. Even an Eleventh Level perfect holding a supreme weapon could barely save their life in front of Lin Yuan.*

*But compared to a true Twelfth Level being, Lin Yuan lacked any confidence.*

*Firstly, Lin Yuan’s greatest advantage was the Sixth Realm Space-Time Rules comprehension, and most Twelfth Level beings basically had this comprehension.*

*The Eleventh Level perfect impacting the ultimate, as long as they succeeded in the end, would smoothly land and experience the ‘shore’ touch, mostly comprehending the Sixth Realm Space-Time.*

*This was also why the Sixth Realm Space-Time was called the threshold of the Twelfth Level.*

*Having no advantage in Space-Time Fusion comprehension, and even a disadvantage, his physical body and soul also couldn’t compare to the supreme beings. As for his inner world?*

*The supreme being’s inner world transformed into an inner universe, spanning tens of thousands to a hundred thousand light-years, still incomparable to Lin Yuan.*

*The only aspect where Lin Yuan could surpass ordinary Twelfth Levels was his mind and willpower.*

*With a spiritual index as high as 33,330,000 points, it was estimated that most supreme beings in the universe hadn’t reached this level.*

*The mind and willpower were undoubtedly important. Paired with any trump card, it could exert tremendous effect, but if it were just mind and willpower, the effect would be very limited.*

…

*What Lin Yuan meant by that sentence was simple: at the current stage, he couldn’t defeat the supreme beings.*

*But to the Ancient Power Supreme Being’s ears, he mistakenly thought Lin Yuan lacked confidence in stepping into the Twelfth Level.*

*In fact, Lin Yuan was quite confident in impacting the ultimate. Polishing himself at the Eleventh Level, elevating many Pillar-level Fusion Rules to the height of the Twelfth Level.*

*Even if he didn’t comprehend the Chaos Rule in the end, Lin Yuan still had a substantial hope of impacting the ultimate.*

*This hope stemmed not only from his solid foundation,*

*but also from many external factors, like that ‘Heart of Space-Time.’*

*The ability to extend his stay in the river of time’s time had an against-the-odds effect, equivalent to forcibly elevating the possibility of stepping into the Twelfth Level.*

“Lin Yuan, your current strength?”

The Void God Ultimate Being looked at Lin Yuan and asked.

With these words spoken,

the other eight supreme beings also looked at Lin Yuan.

“Probably stronger than the Eleventh Level by some,”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment and answered truthfully.

“Some? How much stronger?”

The Void God Ultimate Being couldn’t help but ask.

There were six grades in the Eleventh Level. Lin Yuan was stronger than which grade of the Eleventh Level?

“About… compared to me, Eleventh Level perfect is like the Tenth Level compared to the Eleventh Level, I suppose.”

Lin Yuan said, actually elevating the Eleventh Level perfect as much as possible. In reality, the gap between Eleventh Level perfect and Lin Yuan was only greater.

“Like the Tenth Level compared to the Eleventh Level?”

The nine supreme beings of human civilization fell into silence. Was this called only a bit stronger?

The limit of a Tenth Rank Evolver was to comprehend a certain Pillar-level Fusion Rule at the Second Realm.

But Eleventh Level perfect? Space-Time Fifth Realm, involving many Pillar-level Fusion Rules.
